companies.name: Gupshup
companies.description: Gupshup is a conversational AI platform that enables businesses to build and deploy AI agents for marketing, commerce, and customer support across messaging channels including WhatsApp, RCS, SMS, Voice, and Web. The platform processes messaging at scale across 130+ countries and offers pre-built, industry-trained AI agents through its Conversation Cloud.

companies.name: Uniphore
companies.description: Uniphore is a business AI company that provides an enterprise platform combining conversational AI, emotion AI, and agentic automation to power customer service, sales, marketing, and HR functions. Its Business AI Cloud platform integrates data, knowledge, models, and AI agents in a composable, sovereign architecture for enterprise deployments.

companies.name: Skit.ai
companies.headquarters: New York, USA (with offices in Bengaluru, India)
companies.description: Skit.ai (formerly Vernacular.ai) builds AI-powered conversational agents for the accounts receivable and debt collections industry, automating multichannel consumer engagement across voice, SMS, email, and chat. The platform combines predictive analytics, compliance enforcement, and generative AI to manage end-to-end collection workflows.

agents.tagline: Pre-built, industry-trained AI agents that automate B2C engagement across the full customer lifecycle.
agents.description: Gupshup AI Agent Library is a suite of 15 pre-built and customizable AI agents designed for B2C engagement spanning marketing, sales, and support. The library includes specialized agents such as Lead Generation AI Agent (collects, qualifies, and nurtures leads with drip campaigns), Product Discovery AI Agent (provides consultative product recommendations and comparisons), Collections AI Agent (sends payment reminders and collects EMI payments), and Order Management AI Agent (handles tracking, returns, and delivery optimization). Each agent leverages industry-trained LLMs with built-in safety guardrails to prevent hallucinations while maintaining brand consistency, and can be deployed across WhatsApp, SMS, RCS, Voice, Web, and Mobile channels. The agents support tool-call prompting to connect with external systems like CRMs, catalogs, ticketing platforms, and payment gateways in real time.

use_cases.title: Automated lead qualification and nurturing for real estate and fintech
consultative product discovery and recommendations for e-commerce
order tracking, returns management, and delivery optimization for retail
payment collection and reminder automation for financial services

expected_outcomes: Dramatically accelerated time-to-market for conversational AI deployments
reduced customer support costs through automated self-service resolution
increased conversion rates via personalized, consultative engagement

agents.tagline: Human-like voice AI agents that automate 80% of contact center calls across 100+ languages.
agents.description: Gupshup Voice AI is an AI-powered voice automation platform that deploys human-like voice agents to handle inbound and outbound calls at scale. The platform supports custom voice cloning for brand-consistent experiences, advanced interruption handling for natural conversational flow, and contextual intelligence that leverages full interaction history for personalized responses. It operates across 100+ languages with ultra-low latency and integrates with PSTN, WhatsApp Business Calling, and web/app click-to-call interfaces. The system orchestrates across multiple speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and AI providers to deliver multi-modal voice experiences.

use_cases.title: Automated lead qualification and appointment scheduling via outbound voice calls
collections management with payment reminders and resolution
customer support query handling with seamless human agent handoff
proactive marketing outreach and feedback collection

expected_outcomes: 75-80% automation of self-serve support queries
60% reduction in inbound support call volume

agents.tagline: AI-powered campaign optimization that reduces messaging costs by 25% through intelligent targeting and personalization.
agents.description: Gupshup AI Campaign Copilot is a marketing automation tool that uses AI to optimize messaging campaign performance across channels. It includes AI Propensity Scoring that identifies high-affinity customers through predictive modeling and suppresses low-engagement audiences to reduce wasted spend. The platform provides Auto Language Personalization using generative AI translation across 10+ vernacular languages, AI Send Time Optimization that delivers messages during optimal engagement windows based on behavioral patterns, and multi-level channel failover that automatically routes messages through RCS, WhatsApp, and SMS based on availability. It also generates custom brand-compliant visual content and copywriting through its AI Creatives capability.

use_cases.title: Post-purchase customer re-engagement campaigns with personalized timing and language
retention campaigns with propensity-based targeting to reduce churn
lead nurturing sequences with automated channel failover for maximum reach
cost-optimized promotional campaigns across multilingual customer bases

expected_outcomes: Up to 25% reduction in cost per campaign through intelligent audience suppression
21-35% higher read rates via send-time optimization and language personalization

agents.tagline: Unified inbox with AI copilot that empowers human agents to support better and sell more.
agents.description: Gupshup Agent Assist is a customer support and sales enablement platform that equips human agents with AI-driven tools and unified customer context. The platform features intelligent routing that automatically assigns queries to agents based on skills, availability, and historical interactions, eliminating manual ticket triage. Its embedded AI Copilot provides AI Summarize (concise session summaries with sentiment analysis), AI Suggested Replies (context-aware response recommendations), AI Expand (transforms brief inputs into detailed professional replies), and AI Rephrase (polishes responses for grammar, clarity, and brand consistency). The system enables assisted selling by surfacing complete customer context including campaign source, chat history, and past purchases to agents engaging high-intent leads.

use_cases.title: Real-time agent-assisted selling with full customer context from CRM for high-intent leads
AI-augmented customer support with automated summarization and suggested responses
hybrid support model where AI handles routine queries and seamlessly hands off complex issues to human agents
outbound engagement campaigns managed by human agents with AI productivity tools

expected_outcomes: Increased agent productivity through AI-assisted response creation and summarization
improved customer satisfaction via intelligent routing and personalized interactions

agents.tagline: AI-powered in-call copilot that equips contact center agents with instant guidance, contextual knowledge, and automated after-call work.
agents.description: Real-Time Guidance Agent delivers intelligent assistance during live customer interactions by surfacing pre-call context from CRM systems and historical data. It provides dynamic prompts, next-best-action recommendations, and contextual knowledge retrieval grounded in enterprise data during conversations. The agent automatically generates conversation summaries capturing intent, actions, and outcomes, eliminating manual after-call work. A manager dashboard offers real-time transcription, performance analytics, and coaching insights across the entire contact center operation.

use_cases.title: Reducing average handle time for customer service calls
accelerating new agent onboarding and training
improving first-contact resolution rates
automating post-call documentation and administrative tasks

expected_outcomes: Significant reduction in average handle time
faster agent onboarding
improved first-contact resolution

agents.tagline: Emotionally intelligent virtual agent that engages like a human across voice, chat, and text channels.
agents.description: Self-Service Agent is an AI-powered virtual agent that handles customer support interactions autonomously across multiple channels including voice, chat, and text. It uses sentiment and intent detection to recognize emotional context and deliver empathetic, personalized responses. The platform includes a no-code Unified Conversation Designer that allows business users to build and modify experiences without technical expertise. It integrates with enterprise knowledge bases for accurate real-time responses and includes gen AI-powered training that automatically generates training phrases to improve intent accuracy.

use_cases.title: Automating routine customer inquiries without human involvement
reducing agent transfer rates for common support scenarios
scaling multilingual customer support operations
lowering customer effort across self-service channels

expected_outcomes: Improved self-service resolution rates
reduced agent transfer volume
higher customer satisfaction scores

agents.tagline: Gen AI-powered conversational intelligence that extracts actionable insights from every customer interaction using natural language queries.
agents.description: Conversation Insights Agent employs generative AI to analyze customer interactions at scale, enabling contact center leaders to extract targeted insights through natural language prompts without needing keywords, tags, or technical expertise. It automates quality assurance across 100% of calls, identifying coaching needs, compliance gaps, and performance trends with evidence-backed scoring. The agent generates LLM-powered conversation summaries that capture what happened, the underlying reasons, and customer sentiment. It tracks emerging issues, monitors agent and customer sentiment patterns, and integrates insights into AI workflows that drive operational outcomes.

use_cases.title: Automating quality monitoring across all customer calls
identifying compliance risks and coaching opportunities
uncovering emerging product and service issues from customer feedback
tracking customer and agent sentiment trends over time

expected_outcomes: Full-coverage automated quality assurance
faster identification of compliance and performance issues
data-driven coaching and operational improvement

agents.tagline: AI-native customer data platform that transforms interaction data into real-time marketing intelligence with zero-copy architecture.
agents.description: CDP Agent is an AI-first, composable customer data platform that connects to existing data sources without requiring data migration or copying. It delivers real-time predictive insights for churn identification and high-value customer recognition, and automates personalization across customer touchpoints. The platform provides identity resolution, audience segmentation from natural language prompts, and journey orchestration capabilities. Its agentic features enable marketers to build sophisticated audience segments, activate campaigns in real time, and optimize customer journeys through AI-driven automation.

automating personalized campaign activation across channels
predicting customer churn and identifying high-value segments
reducing customer acquisition costs through AI-optimized targeting

reduced customer acquisition costs
improved digital engagement performance

agents.tagline: AI-powered sales copilot that delivers real-time buyer sentiment analysis and post-meeting intelligence to close deals faster.
agents.description: Sales Interaction Agent uses emotion AI and generative AI to provide live meeting insights during virtual sales interactions. It measures buyer reactions in real time, pinpointing which content and messaging truly resonates with prospects. The agent provides data-driven insights into buyer engagement, sentiment, and emotion alongside seller performance metrics. It auto-generates precise post-meeting summaries, enables natural language querying across past interactions and deal history, and delivers targeted AI micro-coaching to improve seller soft skills and team performance.

improving win rates through data-driven selling behaviors

agents.tagline: AI-native platform that turns scattered collection data into decision-ready strategies and automated omnichannel recovery campaigns.
agents.description: The Collection Intelligence Platform is Skit.ai's core AI engine built on a proprietary Large Collection Model (LCM) that predicts collection propensity based on consumer demographics, financial behavior, and debt details. It unifies customer identity and context across CRM, ERP, telephony, and third-party data sources to create actionable cohorts segmented by balance, delinquency, and payment patterns. The platform includes a Journey Builder that converts cohorts into milestone-based engagement structures with customizable content, channel, cadence, and compliance rules per segment. Its iterative modeling capability recalibrates strategies daily and weekly based on interaction outcomes, automatically scaling successful approaches and throttling underperformers within compliance-aware feedback loops.

use_cases.title: Automating end-to-end debt recovery campaigns across voice, email, SMS, and chat
predicting optimal contact timing and channel for each consumer cohort
identifying high-probability recovery accounts to prioritize collection efforts
continuous campaign optimization through outcome-driven strategy refinement

expected_outcomes: Higher recovery rates with reduced operational costs
improved consumer experience through personalized, compliant outreach
faster campaign deployment (go-live in under 48 hours)

agents.tagline: A coordinated suite of specialized AI agents that autonomously manage every stage of the collections lifecycle from strategy to post-campaign learning.
agents.description: The AI Agent Ecosystem is Skit.ai's multi-agent architecture comprising purpose-built agents that operate across the full collection workflow. Pre-campaign Decisioning Agents validate portfolios, form consumer cohorts, and define compliant engagement strategies before outreach begins. Conversational Agents handle live voice, email, SMS, and chat interactions using account context, conversation history, and real-time sentiment signals to guide consumers toward payment, promises, callbacks, or escalation. Orchestration Agents coordinate agent sequencing, manage channel switches, and handle escalation paths in real time. Compliance Agents enforce regulatory guardrails (FDCPA, TCPA, Reg F, UDAAP, HIPAA, PCI-DSS) across all decisions and conversations, while QA, Insight, and Learning Agents audit quality, extract performance insights, and continuously update models for improved outcomes.

use_cases.title: Autonomous multi-channel consumer outreach for first-party and third-party collections
real-time negotiation and dispute resolution without human intervention
compliance-monitored payment collection with wrong-party detection and bankruptcy flagging
post-campaign quality auditing and strategy refinement

expected_outcomes: Up to 40% reduction in overall cost of collections
100% account penetration across outbound use cases
automated resolution of accounts at scale with built-in regulatory compliance
